title: The apply-migration workflow counts only approvals of the PR's head commit as the second person's approval

source.ref: Scan nine (2026-10-19 weekly meta scan), docs/META-SCAN-STATUS.md

detail: SCAN-847 made the production migration workflow require an APPROVED review from someone other than the author (or an admin dispatcher). The jq filter took each reviewer's latest review without comparing its commit_id to the head SHA the workflow had just pinned, so an approval of an earlier commit still passed after new migration SQL was pushed, unless branch protection dismisses stale approvals (a repo setting the code cannot see). The step now receives the pinned head SHA and counts only reviews of that commit.

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const w=fs.readFileSync('.github/workflows/apply-migration.yml','utf8');const i=w.indexOf(\"Require a second person's approval\");const b=i<0?'':w.slice(i,i+1500);if(!/SHA:\\s*\\$\\{\\{\\s*steps\\.pr\\.outputs\\.sha\\s*\\}\\}/.test(b)||!/select\\(\\.commit_id == /.test(b)){console.error('SCAN-1002: the second-person approval step accepts an approval of an older commit');process.exit(1)}"
